title: Population by county
description: Estimated number of people living in each county on July 1 of each year.
howToRead: Annual estimates built from births, deaths and migration, restarted from each census count (2000, 2010, 2020).
caveats: Connecticut replaced its counties with planning regions in 2022, so it appears as no data on the county map.
Estimates are rebased after each census, so a small jump at 2010 or 2020 can reflect the new census count rather than people moving.
Counties that were created or merged since 2000 start in the year they appear.
